scope: One real-weight representative projection for each of eight unique MatMulNBits shapes, each with a synthetic BF16 input and one direct-DD NPU execute

method.input: Synthetic standard-normal float32 vector rounded to BF16, not captured RMSNorm/model activations
method.cpu_reference: FP64 dequantized MatMul+bias using exactly the BF16-rounded input and original quantized projection tensors
method.new_seven_reference_memory: Output-major 256-channel chunks, maximum FP64 weight chunk 18 MiB; no whole FP64 weight matrix
method.tolerance: All outputs finite; every absolute linear error within (4*u_bf16+gamma_K_fp32)*sumabs + u_bf16*abs(reference); relative RMSE <= 0.03125
method.configuration: MladfMatMul v2, no control packets, is_llm=false, state table commands removed; each direct probe initializes once, executes once, retries zero times
method.source_integrity: Source hash, metadata, compiled state, fixture and output evidence are bound by the listed SHA256 records; original weight range/constant hashes are preserved from the preparation/compile evidence
method.timing: Single execute diagnostic observations, not throughput or repeatability benchmarks
method.report_processing: CPU-only; no new model weight reads, host compilation, NPU initialization, or NPU execution

row_evidence.float_encoding: Python shortest round-tripping decimal representation of each stored float64; all fields reread and exactly checked
row_evidence.empty_fields: The old 32-output fixture did not retain sumabs, so that field is empty for those 32 rows. CPU sigmoid columns exist only for that old case; all seven new shapes have empty sigmoid columns.

cases.original_range_note: Original localized source proof is retained in the prior 32-output direct evidence and its source hashes

host_compile.qualification: Original run2 report failed an overly strict unchanged-scratch postcondition; separate hash-pinned validation confirms the intended no-state scratch/transaction changes.

tolerance.pass_rule: All finite, every linear component within its budget, and linear normalized RMSE <= 8*u_bf16; derived CPU Sigmoid also within its declared budget
tolerance.qualification: Predeclared BF16-based diagnostic thresholds; not a guarantee of the undocumented internal BFP16 reduction order

numerical_summary.sigmoid_execution_location: CPU postprocessing of raw DD linear output

limitations: Eight representative projections cover the eight shape classes, not all 249 distinct weight tensors or layer-specific inputs.
These are M=1 isolated direct-DD calls. They do not validate the complete token graph, prefill graph, mixed branch integration, or state evolution over a sequence.
The lm_head check includes every one of its 248320 output channels but does not establish end-to-end token selection or generation.
No full-model 16K context, EOS behavior, or fused Token Fusion artifact is established by these tests.
This report summarizes the selected successful configuration. Earlier exploratory failed experiments are separate evidence and are not counted as these eight successful calls.
The budgets are predeclared BF16-based diagnostics, not a proof of undocumented internal BFP16 reduction order.
